2026-11-12 (PST) — SUPERSEDES the engine-comparison figures recorded on this epic from the run committed at 73848dd1f40. Those figures came from a harness that dropped findings past the advisory cap from the overlap count, could mix in stale resumed records, and did not record which provider or model ran; that run also used the Anthropic API config. The fixed harness (vegetarian-mica-phoebe, Gerrit 3390, merged 18d9ab335d6) was re-run fresh on Bedrock (REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE=.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml, AWS_PROFILE=frontier-bedrock), 2026-11-12 21:48–22:26 PST, over the same 11-row corpus. Committed in src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/engine_comparison_results.json (schema_version 2, valid true).
- Verdict agreement: 8/11 (0.727). Pipeline→agentic: PASS→PASS 6, PASS→BLOCK 2, BLOCK→BLOCK 2, BLOCK→PASS 1. Blocking flips: 3.
- Finding overlap: matched 0, pipeline_only 120, agentic_only 58.
- Agreement with the historical pipeline verdict: pipeline 6/10, agentic 5/10.
- No rows excluded.
- Runner pydantic_ai throughout. The pipeline records name bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5 (the verifier-class model stamped on the verdict); the agentic records name bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5.
